paras: Enhance the aerodynamic performance and aesthetics of your Honda Civic FL5 with the our new AT-R4 Swan Neck Wing. Meticulously crafted with precision engineering, this wing is designed to deliver unparalleled downforce, improving high-speed stability and handling. Featuring a distinctive swan neck mount, the AT-R4 Wing minimizes drag while providing optimal airflow over your vehicle, making it perfect for both track enthusiasts and street drivers who demand peak performance.

Constructed from high-quality, lightweight prepreg carbon fibre, the wing not only boosts performance but also adds a sleek, aggressive look to your Civic FL5. Engineered to complement the Civic's design, it offers both functionality and style in one seamless package.
